create.name: Clockwork folds
create.description: Three broad rectangular cog folds rise from the main head, with a backward leading block and flat brass caps. Forehead Engineer's Goggles carry the Create equipment cue.

refined_storage.name: Quartz droplet
refined_storage.description: A broad quartz root steps into a squared central droplet with a flat storage-colored cap.

draconic_evolution.name: Wyvern crown
draconic_evolution.description: Two thick, outward and backward rotated wyvern horns flank one low rectangular dorsal ridge.

astral_sorcery.name: Crescent cranium
astral_sorcery.description: Two broad tilted lunar forks frame a low star basin; each fork is a rectangular root and flat terminal cap.

blood_magic.name: Ritual droplet head
blood_magic.description: Large ritual-slate steps rise into a blocky ruby droplet crown with one broad red terminal cap.

ars_nouveau.name: Starbuncle tuft head
ars_nouveau.description: Two broad Starbuncle ear blocks surround a short central source tuft, using rectangular roots and flat caps.

occultism.name: Otherworld wisp head
occultism.description: One broad offset spirit hook and a low shoulder block suggest an Otherworld wisp through a few chunky rotated pieces.

iron_spells.name: Arcane wave head
iron_spells.description: One broad rearward spell-wave block rises between two short tilted temple folds and ends in a flat cap.

projecte.name: Philosopher diamond head
projecte.description: Dark-matter shoulders step through three large blocks into a flat Philosopher's Stone-colored tip.

malum.name: Soulwood flame head
malum.description: Three unequal soulwood spirit blocks lean in different directions, with a taller offset middle lobe and flat spirit-colored caps.

cataclysm.name: Ignis furnace crown
cataclysm.description: Two large rotated Ignis forks grow from the top of the original head, with a low furnace root and flat warm caps.

ice_fire.name: Swept dragon crown
ice_fire.description: Two thick rear-swept dragon horn blocks flank a low rectangular dorsal ridge; their ends remain visibly cut off.

aether.name: Cloudwing crown
aether.description: A broad cloud root supports two tilted rectangular cloud lobes and a low sky-colored cap.

twilight_forest.name: Twilight antlerbud crown
twilight_forest.description: Two broad forest antler-bud blocks have compact rectangular side branches and golden flat tips.

cobblemon.name: Partner creature crown
cobblemon.description: Two chunky partner-ear blocks flank a short rectangular brow tuft, while the capture-ball marker carries the explicit mod cue.

born_in_chaos.name: Crooked pumpkin crown
born_in_chaos.description: Two broad pumpkin blocks support a short crooked rectangular stalk with a flat terminal band.
